title: Longer LK5 Pro – Large Format Budget 3D Printer
excerpt: The Longer LK5 Pro is a large‑format FDM 3D printer designed for beginners who want to print big objects with good quality at an affordable price.
body:
## Overview The Longer LK5 Pro is a budget‑friendly large‑format 3D printer aimed at beginners who want to print larger objects without investing in an expensive machine. With its generous build volume, intuitive touchscreen and simple manual bed leveling, it offers an accessible entry into large‑scale FDM printing. ## What’s in the Box The LK5 Pro is delivered partially pre‑assembled and includes everything needed to get started: - Base with print bed and Y‑axis - Frame and support bars - X‑axis with pre‑mounted print head - Z‑axis screw rod and stepper motor - Textured glass print bed - Touchscreen - Filament holder - Power cable and filament sample - Tools (spatula, wrench, Allen key) - Micro SD card and card reader - Instruction manual ## Assembly & Setup Assembly is straightforward and can be completed within a few minutes. The X‑axis comes pre‑assembled, so there is no need to mount the hotend, extruder or filament sensor. The Z‑axis is mounted by fixing the stepper motor at the base and guiding the lead screw through the X‑axis. Once the frame is secured to the base, adjustable diagonal support bars help achieve a perfect 90° angle, ensuring stability during printing. All cables are clearly labeled, making incorrect connections almost impossible. ## Print Bed Leveling The LK5 Pro uses manual print bed leveling. A built‑in leveling menu moves the nozzle to five points on the print bed, where leveling is done using the classic paper method. At each point, the nozzle should be close enough to the bed so that a sheet of paper can move with slight resistance. Manual leveling may require a few passes, but once properly set, it delivers consistent first layers. ## Technical Specifications **Device** - Technology: FDM - Size: 580 × 540 × 663 mm - Weight: 13.5 kg - Touchscreen: 4.3‑inch color touchscreen - Structure: Partially pre‑assembled - Power supply: 110 V / 220 V **Printing** - Print volume: 300 × 300 × 400 mm - Extruder type: Bowden - Print bed leveling: Manual - Accuracy: 0.1 mm - Layer thickness: 0.1–0.4 mm - Nozzle diameter: 0.4 mm - Filament diameter: 1.75 mm - Max bed temperature: 100 °C - Max nozzle temperature: 250 °C - Print speed: Max 180 mm/s (recommended 60–80 mm/s) ## Final Thoughts The Longer LK5 Pro is easy to assemble, simple to operate and offers an impressive build volume for its price range. It is a solid option for makers who want to explore large‑format 3D printing without jumping straight into high‑end machines. ## Image Gallery
